about.story.p2: Our diverse team brings together expertise in artificial intelligence, user experience design, and software development to create a tool that bridges the gap between imagination and implementation.
about.vision.title: Our Vision

about.vision.p2: Our goal is to become the go-to platform for rapid prototyping, helping teams focus on what matters most: innovation and user experience.

quickstart.hero.title: Quick Start Guide
quickstart.hero.subtitle: Learn how to go from idea to generated UI in a few simple steps.
quickstart.step1.title: 1. Sign in and open the Dashboard
quickstart.step1.p1: After you log in, you will land on the Dashboard. Here you can see your existing projects or start a new one.
quickstart.step1.item1: Create Project button in the left sidebar opens the project creation dialog.
quickstart.step1.item2: Dashboard shows all your projects as cards with title and description.
quickstart.step1.item3: Click any project card to continue designing it in the Design page.
quickstart.step2.title: 2. Create a new project
quickstart.step2.item1: Click Create Project in the Dashboard sidebar.
quickstart.step2.item2: Choose the target device: Mobile or Desktop.
quickstart.step2.item3: Select an AI Model based on speed and quality requirements.
quickstart.step2.item4: Describe your project in plain English in the description box.
quickstart.step2.item5: You can click Try example or Improve with AI to optimize the prompt.
quickstart.step2.item6: Click Continue to generate your first version of the UI.
quickstart.step3.title: 3. Work in the Design page
quickstart.step3.p1: The Design page is your main AI design workspace. It uses your project description or uploaded assets to generate UI layouts.
quickstart.step3.item1: Use text prompts, screenshots, or sketches to generate designs.
quickstart.step3.item2: Adjust colors, layout, and components as needed.
quickstart.step3.item3: Preview different pages and sections of the generated UI.
quickstart.step3.item4: When you are satisfied, you can export the design to code.
quickstart.step4.title: 4. Use the Editor to Refine Your Design
quickstart.step4.p1: The Editor is where you can manually refine the AI-generated UI. It provides a rich set of tools to modify the design to your exact specifications.
quickstart.step4.item1: Real-time Preview: See your changes live as you make them.
quickstart.step4.item2: Component Palette: Drag and drop new elements like buttons, forms, and containers.
quickstart.step4.item3: Style Editor: Adjust colors, fonts, spacing, and other CSS properties.
quickstart.step4.item4: Save Page: When you're happy with the design, you can save it to update your project.
quickstart.step5.title: 5. Manage and iterate on projects
quickstart.step5.item1: All generated designs are saved as projects in the Dashboard.
quickstart.step5.item2: You can reopen any project from the Dashboard project cards.
quickstart.step5.item3: Use Delete Projects in the sidebar if you need to clean up old work.
quickstart.step5.item4: Visit Membership to upgrade and unlock more generation capacity and models.
quickstart.tips.title: Tips for better results
quickstart.tips.specific.title: Be specific in your prompt
quickstart.tips.specific.desc: Describe layout, target audience, style (e.g. "SaaS dashboard, dark theme, 2-column layout").
quickstart.tips.simple.title: Start simple
quickstart.tips.simple.desc: Generate a basic version first, then iterate with more detailed prompts.
quickstart.tips.examples.title: Use examples
quickstart.tips.examples.desc: Reference known products ("similar to Apple Store page") to guide the AI faster.
quickstart.tips.refine.title: Refine and export
quickstart.tips.refine.desc: Use the Design page to tweak details, then export code when you are happy with the result.
quickstart.cta.title: Ready to build your first UI?
quickstart.cta.description: Log in, create a project on the Dashboard, and generate your first design in minutes.
